claims.text: With the browser preferring dark, DonHang.App at localhost:8081 shows the product list on an almost black page (surface 0xFF121318) with light text and a deep indigo refresh button (primaryContainer 0xFF394379); the app has no light/dark button.
claims.source_hint: headless Chrome on the stage-2 lab with Emulation.setEmulatedMedia prefers-color-scheme dark (screenshot); DonHang.App/lib @ stage-2 has no themeMode or toggle

claims.text: MaterialApp (and MaterialApp.router) takes darkTheme next to theme; themeMode chooses between them: ThemeMode.system follows the platform brightness, ThemeMode.light always uses theme, ThemeMode.dark always uses darkTheme.
claims.source_hint: Flutter API: MaterialApp.darkTheme, MaterialApp.themeMode, ThemeMode enum

claims.text: ThemeData(colorSchemeSeed: seed, brightness: Brightness.dark) generates the dark color scheme from the same seed (as ColorScheme.fromSeed with brightness dark); no value is picked by hand.
claims.source_hint: Flutter API: ThemeData colorSchemeSeed and brightness, ColorScheme.fromSeed(brightness:)

claims.text: From the indigo seed: surface 0xFFFBF8FF (light) / 0xFF121318 (dark); onSurface 0xFF1B1B21 / 0xFFE4E1E9; primary 0xFF515B92 / 0xFFBAC3FF; primaryContainer (FAB fill) 0xFFDEE0FF / 0xFF394379: same roles, different values.
claims.source_hint: flutter test on a stage-2 archive printing both ColorSchemes

claims.text: themeMode defaults to ThemeMode.system; with it, MaterialApp uses darkTheme when the platform brightness is dark and switches when that setting changes while the app runs.
claims.source_hint: Flutter API: MaterialApp.themeMode default; flutter test on a stage-2 archive (platformBrightnessTestValue dark -> Theme.of brightness dark, live change)

claims.text: On the web, Flutter's platform brightness is the page's prefers-color-scheme preference, which the browser sets, usually from the device's appearance; changing it updates the running app without a reload.
claims.source_hint: Flutter web engine (platform_dispatcher: matchMedia prefers-color-scheme); headless Chrome on the stage-2 lab: emulated dark switched the page live

claims.text: Widgets reading Theme.of(context).colorScheme get the scheme MaterialApp picked, so code naming a role needs no change for dark mode; a hardcoded color such as Colors.red is the same in both modes.
claims.source_hint: Flutter API: Theme.of; flutter test on a stage-2 archive (colorScheme in light vs dark)

claims.text: At stage-2 main.dart lines 31-32 build theme and darkTheme from Colors.indigo, the dark one adding brightness: Brightness.dark; useMaterial3 is no longer written; there is no themeMode argument.
At stage-2 no file in DonHang.App/lib writes a Colors.* value except the seed in main.dart; create_order_screen.dart:108 shows the server error with Theme.of(context).colorScheme.error.
claims.source_hint: git grep 'Colors\.' stage-2 -- DonHang.App/lib; examples/don-hang @ stage-2: DonHang.App/lib/screens/create_order_screen.dart:107-108

claims.text: The dark scheme's error from the indigo seed is 0xFFFFB4AB, a lighter red than the light scheme's 0xFFBA1A1A.
claims.source_hint: flutter test on a stage-2 archive printing colorScheme.error for both themes

claims.text: Inverting the light primary 0xFF515B92 gives 0xFFAEA46D, a khaki yellow, while the generated dark primary is 0xFFBAC3FF, a light indigo.
claims.source_hint: arithmetic 0xFF - each channel of 0x515B92; flutter test on a stage-2 archive for dark primary

claims.text: A MaterialApp with no darkTheme uses theme even when the platform brightness is dark.
claims.source_hint: Flutter API: MaterialApp.darkTheme ('If null, theme is used'); flutter test on a stage-2 archive (no darkTheme, platform dark -> light)

claims.text: Try it: switching the device to dark, or DevTools command menu (Ctrl+Shift+P) 'Emulate CSS prefers-color-scheme: dark', turns the page almost black with light names and prices, and the refresh button from pale lavender to deep indigo, without reload.
claims.source_hint: headless Chrome on the stage-2 lab (emulated media light vs dark screenshots); product_list_screen.dart:34 FloatingActionButton @ stage-2; Chrome DevTools docs: Rendering / command menu

claims.text: Adding themeMode: ThemeMode.light to MaterialApp.router makes the app always use theme; deleting darkTheme would also keep it light.
claims.source_hint: Flutter API: MaterialApp.themeMode, MaterialApp.router themeMode parameter; claim 12

self_check.notes: Colors and mode switching checked by flutter test on a stage-2 archive (theme/darkTheme, platform brightness, no darkTheme) and headless Chrome on the lab with emulated prefers-color-scheme (live switch). No toggle, stored choice or contrast numbers (depth_notes). R1: refresh button as primaryContainer, useMaterial3 sentence removed, ARB and DevTools glossed, claim 6 hedged, q2 c reworded.
